---
title: Chapters without numbered sections
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
crossref:
  chapters: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -q 'Figure 2' && ! pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -qE 'Figure [0-9]+\.[0-9]'
    typst:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'sections:.*number-sections'
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - []
        - ['typst-extras']
---
